# it holds no schedule of its own, so adding a ritual is a row here rather than
# an edit to the logic. Delete the rows you do not run.
# cadence: weekday | weekly | monthly | adhoc   (adhoc is tracked, never overdue)
# grace:   extra days allowed before the ritual counts as overdue
